audience: businesses that run their phone lines and SMS on Zadarma

useCases.title: Check the balance and the call rates
useCases.text: Read the account balance and the price plan. Then look up the per-minute rate for one destination number.

useCases.title: See which SIP and PBX extensions are online
useCases.text: List the SIP numbers and PBX extensions of the account. Check whether one extension is online before you route a call to it.

useCases.title: Review the calls of a period and fetch a recording
useCases.text: Read the call statistics for a period, then get a temporary download link for one recording. Statistics allow 3 calls per minute.

useCases.title: List the virtual numbers and SMS templates
useCases.text: List the virtual phone numbers rented on the account. Then list the SMS templates by category before you write a message.

useCases.title: Send an SMS to up to 10 numbers
useCases.text: Send one SMS to up to 10 phone numbers. Each send uses the account balance and is not retried, so check the result first.
